summary: @ornikar/typed-css-modules-loader ships preinstall alternate-runtime dropper executing obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime archive from GitHub releases (oven-sh/bun), extracts the `bun` binary to a temporary directory, chmods it to 0755, and executes it against a sibling file `math_init.js` via `execFileSync`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB heavily obfuscated Bun-CommonJS script using obfuscator.io-style transformations (hex-mangled identifiers, a >900-element constant array, a string-array-rotator function, and a base64-alphabet decoder), which cannot be fully statically deobfuscated. The package's advertised surface — a Webpack loader for typed-css-modules — is a verbatim copy of the legitimate upstream `typed-css-modules-loader` by Oleg Stepura (including upstream repository and author metadata) used as cover; the malicious preinstall hook and the obfuscated `math_init.js` are additions not present upstream. The alternate-runtime pattern (dropping a freshly downloaded runtime to execute the payload) bypasses Node-based inspection. The `@ornikar` scope is a real organization, indicating scope-namespace abuse, dependency confusion, or account/scope compromise targeting Ornikar consumers.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
